energy_model.distance_rule: Euclidean straight-line distance in the site-local plane.
energy_model.feasibility_rule: battery_available - outbound_cost - capture_cost - return_cost - return_reserve >= 0 AND actions_remaining > 0 AND asset/view eligible
energy_model.capture_debit_rule: Debit outbound_cost + capture_cost exactly once for an executed capture; update position to the asset. Return cost and reserve are protected, not debited on capture.
energy_model.return_debit_rule: On an eventual executed return, debit distance(current_position, launch_point) * travel_energy_per_m once.
energy_model.limitations: Toy simulation; no calibrated aircraft battery, weather, obstacle routing, altitude, takeoff or landing model. Capture cost includes an invented dwell allowance.

energy_model.distance_rule: Euclidean straight-line distance in the site-local plane.
energy_model.feasibility_rule: battery_available - outbound_cost - capture_cost - return_cost - return_reserve >= 0 AND actions_remaining > 0 AND asset/view eligible
energy_model.capture_debit_rule: Debit outbound_cost + capture_cost exactly once for an executed capture; update position to the asset. Return cost and reserve are protected, not debited on capture.
energy_model.return_debit_rule: On an eventual executed return, debit distance(current_position, launch_point) * travel_energy_per_m once.
energy_model.limitations: Toy simulation; no calibrated aircraft battery, weather, obstacle routing, altitude, takeoff or landing model. Capture cost includes an invented dwell allowance.
